title: •Boba Fett’s Blaster Rifle
caption: •Boba Fett’s Blaster Rifle (V)
game_text: Deploy on non-{maintenance} Boba Fett. During your turn, opponent’s characters here may not use landspeed. While a captive at same site, your Force drains are +1 here. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Sawed off BlasTech EE-3 blaster rifle. Although its barrel is a few centimeters under the legal limit, no one has lived to file an official complaint.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Fett’s); wiki page title uses a straight one. Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. Inline icon in 'Deploy on non-[gold spoked wheel] Boba Fett' → {maintenance} per this run's instructions (the wiki stub reads it as 'non-Independent' — note the stub's reading differs; the same gold wheel glyph is {maintenance} on vs6/27 and vs5/11). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. The wiki's default page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px CC-D-bobafettsblasterrifle.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face) — downloaded to src/vs6/30-CC-D-bobafettsblasterrifle.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: V5-D-bobafettsblasterrifle.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 5 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
